actual_coverage.geography: United States industrial aggregates plus global semiconductor nominal sales
actual_coverage.frequency: Monthly and quarterly publisher releases; no weekly interpolation

limitations: G.17 coverage is a reused current-vintage six-month aggregate panel, not a 36-month historical or sector panel.
SIA/WSTS observations are nominal global sales and cannot establish physical chip output, fabrication geography, price/mix, inventories or final demand.
The June 2026 SIA sales value differs across consecutive release summaries, making release-vintage sensitivity material.
Census M3 remains blocked by an unresolved prior reservation; ISM and USGS were not acquired in this bounded pass.
Original publisher-body identity is not established for either tool-derived representation.
